chunks: Say: 'My Lord is not concerned on your account if you do not pray to Him. You have surely done with denying; soon will come the inevitable judgement.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Du'a in relation to God's attention according to Surah Al-Furqan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores Du'a as the essential mechanism of divine-human interaction, illustrating that God's engagement with creation is contingent upon their invocation. It highlights the relational dynamic where supplication serves as the bridge for divine mercy and attention, reinforcing the concept that worship is not merely ritualistic but a continuous dialogue. The concluding affirmation of inevitable judgment serves as a reminder for those who neglect this spiritual connection.
